pages.title: Inner Space
pages.text: $(thing)Inner Space$()$(br2)A body, seen from the inside at the scale of its cells. Unlocks the Miniaturiser that takes you there, and the materials of its five regions: plasma, matrix fibre, memory cells, nucleotides and tumour specimens. In its Tumour, a Metastatic Spore calls the Tumour Hydra.

$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Circulation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Perfused Tissue, 2 Living Cell.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A body of size l moves at speed u through a fluid of density p and viscosity m. Write the ratio R of its inertia to the fluid's stickiness, which says whether inertia or stickiness wins.
